en.hubeali:
Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Nuh<sup>as</sup> was saying that (in the above Hadeeth) whenever it was morning, so he<sup>as</sup> was Named due to that as a grateful servant’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Whoever Ratifies Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Rescued’.
en.sarwar: 29. Ibn abu ‘Umayr has narrated from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Noah would say the prayer in the previous Hadith every morning and for that reason he is called a thankful person.’
The Imam said, ‘The Messenger of Allah has said, “Whoever accepts the truth from Allah, gains his salvation.”’”
